sections.text:
-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 60 Cost.
Cost recovery boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies a Greater Counter Heal that restores 10% HP when attacked for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Status ailment resistance value boosted by 60 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies buff removal resistance, preventing karma or any buff removal effect one time.
-Target: all allies. Applies Fortify 25% for 150 seconds (when physical or magic damage exceeds a percentage of max HP equal to this effect's value, the total damage is instead converted into fixed damage equal to the same percentage of max HP. This effect reduces by 10 seconds each time it is triggered).
-Target: all allies. Applies Grace for 150 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
-Target: yourself. Applies Azure King's Crest for 120 seconds ([Heraldic] Increases max HP by 500%, increases ATK and MATK 100%, increases status ailment resistance by 50, increases DEF and MDEF for all allies by 100%, increases status ailment resistance for all allies by 50. Only one Heraldic effect may be active at a time (between both allies and enemies). When a new Heraldic effect is activated, the older effect will be removed. This effect is not affected by Time Slice or Time Extend).
Status ailment resistance boosted by 45 when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Miracle.
Confuse and Prohibit Unison Resistance Up by 70
